title: NotesFile
description:
`notes.yaml`: how-to instructions and explanations that several steps share, each named
by the steps that use it.

explain.description: Shared explanations, named by a step's `explain`.

how.description: Shared "How to do it" instructions, named by a step's `how`.

ExplainNote.description: A shared explanation of a test or action.

check.description: What to check: the step's Check, when the step has no `check` of its own.

check_detail.description: More on the check, shown below it when the step has no `check` of its own.

failure.description: What a bad result can mean.

id.description: Unique in the pack; a step's `explain` names it.

if_not.description:
What to do when the check fails: the step's If not, when the step has no `if_not` of
its own.

if_not_detail.description: More on the If not, shown below it when the step has no `if_not` of its own.

success.description: What a good result looks like.

what.description: What the test or action is: the "What it is" line under the step's "How to do it".

why.description: Why it is done: the step's Why, when the step has no `why` of its own.

id.description: Unique in the pack; a step's `how` names it.

steps.description: The instructions, in order: a numbered list under the step's "How to do it".
